name: hexwebmap
description: High-performance worldwide map website in the OpenStreetMap style

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @hexwebmap/api" "npm run dev -w @hexwebmap/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hexwebmap/web && npm run build -w @hexwebmap/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @hexwebmap/shared && npm run test -w @hexwebmap/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @hexwebmap/shared && npm run typecheck -w @hexwebmap/api && npm run typecheck -w @hexwebmap/web
